issue.title: 1.6: Honor pause and exclusions in the MutationObserver

affected_files.role: gating logic; observer callback bypasses pause/exclusion checks
permissions array is [] — missing "storage" so chrome.storage.local is unavailable to content script

match_reasons: acceptance criteria: unit test covers paused + excluded

analysis.summary: Pause and exclusion gating is implemented only inline inside runPixelDetection(); the MutationObserver path in init() invokes sendPixelDetection() directly with no checks, so dynamically injected pixels are recorded even when paused or excluded. Additionally manifest.json declares permissions: [] — without "storage", chrome.storage.local is unavailable in the content script, getFromStorage() resolves {} via its fallback, and even the inline gating silently reads nothing, making persisted pause/exclusion settings inert everywhere.
analysis.details: Failure chain: user pauses extension or excludes a domain (persisted via dashboard) -> chrome.storage.local cannot be read because the "storage" permission is absent (content-script.js getFromStorage falls back to resolving {}) -> runPixelDetection's isPaused/excludedDomains checks see empty values and proceed -> detectFacebookPixel runs and sends. Separately, observeDynamicPixels' callback in init() never consults pause/exclusion state at all, so even with storage fixed, dynamic pixels bypass gating. Fix: extract a single shouldRecord() helper that checks isPaused and isDomainExcluded(hostname, excludedDomains) via storage, call it from both runPixelDetection and the observer callback, and add "storage" to manifest.json permissions. Closes F-BUG-002, F-TEST-004, F-BUG-006.
